item.title: Security guard shot dead in front of Makati condo
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – A 39-year-old security guard was killed in a brazen daylight shooting outside a condominium along Yakal Street in Barangay San Antonio, Makati City, on Sunday morning. Police said the victim, who was on duty at the condominium, was attacked at around 10:40 a.m. while briefly stepping away from his post. item.title: ‘No man helped me achieve this’: Barbie Imperial builds her dream home in Bicol
item.description: MANILA, Philippines – Barbie Imperial could hardly contain her emotions as she broke ground on her own house in Bicol, a dream years in the making. The actress shared highlights of the ceremony and a peek at the home’s design, which will include a garden and pool area, on her Instagram page Tuesday, Jan. 20.
